title: Almost sure local well-posedness for the nonlinear Schrödinger equations on $\Bbb T^d$ with non-algebraic nonlinearity
summary: We study the Cauchy problem for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation on $\mathbb T^d$ with random initial data and a general non-algebraic power-type nonlinearity. We establish almost sure local well-posedness in every spatial dimension and for the whole mass-supercritical range allowed by the natural condition $0<s_{\mathrm c}<1+a$. The main new ingredient is a frequency-gaining probabilistic refinement of the Galilean bilinear estimates recently developed by Kwak and Kwon \cite{KwakKwon}.
